_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the objectives a stage is principally associated with; coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms.

_items_source.document: AQA A-level Sociology (7192) specification: 3.1 Education with Theory and Methods (3.1.1 Education, 3.1.2 Methods in Context, 3.1.3 Theory and Methods); 3.2 Topics in Sociology (Families and Households and Beliefs in Society selected, one from each of the two option groups); 3.3 Crime and Deviance with Theory and Methods (3.3.1 Crime and Deviance, 3.3.2 Theory and Methods)
_items_source.version: The current specification (first teaching from September 2015, unchanged in core structure since), linked from aqa.org.uk/subjects/sociology/a-level/sociology-7192/specification and cross-checked against the AQA-7191-7192-SP-2015.PDF specification document and real AQA mark schemes (e.g. AQA-71921-MS-JUN23, AQA-71922-MS-JUN23, AQA-71923-MS-JUN22), itemised 2026-09-27
_items_source.numbering: AQA numbers this specification's subject content at three levels (3.1 Education with Theory and Methods, containing 3.1.1 Education, 3.1.2 Methods in Context, 3.1.3 Theory and Methods; 3.2 Topics in Sociology, containing eight named option topics split into two groups of four, of which candidates study one per group; 3.3 Crime and Deviance with Theory and Methods, containing 3.3.1 Crime and Deviance and 3.3.2 Theory and Methods) but leaves each subsection's own content as unnumbered bullet points. This course codes Education as EDU1-9, Methods in Context as MIC1, and Theory and Methods (common content examined via both Paper 1 Section C and Paper 3 Section B) as TM1-10; Families and Households (the selected Group 1 option) as FAM1-5 and Beliefs in Society (the selected Group 2 option) as BEL1-5; Crime and Deviance as CD1-11. The six option topics not selected for Paper 2 (Culture and Identity, Health, Work Poverty and Welfare from Group 1; Global Development, The Media, Stratification and Differentiation from Group 2) are itemised at a coarser grain (5 bullets each, coded CULT/HEALTH/WPW/GD/MEDIA/STRAT) purely to record them as declared exclusions; they are not taught.
